description: Kept the latch, moved the cat, and refused to dust a loan.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Carried the folio, barred it from the coffer, and priced the horn at twopence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Left Holinshed and lay on the Knight's Tale.
name: Gib

description: Named by the boy's livery, and not present.
name: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton

description: Named on the slip, and not in the house.
name: John Florio

description: Named as the printer of the Holinshed, and not in the room.
name: Richard Field

description: Read across the three and left the bundle shut.
name: William Shakespeare
